summary: Collection of notebooks showing advanced retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) techniques, from basic RAG to query rewriting, reranking and evaluation.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: RAG Techniques is a learning repository of retrieval-augmented generation methods. Each technique, such as basic RAG, RAG over CSV files, chunk-size tuning, proposition chunking, query transformations, HyDE, contextual chunk headers, memory-augmented retrieval and evaluation, has its own notebook with an explanation and implementation.
sixtySeconds.problem: Basic RAG often returns the wrong passages. This collection shows many tested ways to improve retrieval and answers, in one place, with runnable code.
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a broad, organized tour of RAG techniques with a notebook for each one.
requirements: Python with Jupyter to run the notebooks
Whatever API keys a given notebook uses

overview: Techniques are grouped into categories: foundational, query enhancement, context enrichment, advanced retrieval, iterative and adaptive, evaluation, memory, explainability and advanced architectures.
Clone the repo, open the folder for the technique you want and follow its implementation guide.
It uses a custom non-commercial license, so check the LICENSE file before using the code in a commercial product.
